Results.ReviewText:
This is the first grill I ever owned. I only cook for myself and for one or two visitors. The size is perfect for me. I originally wanted the two burner model but Home Depot accidently shipped this model and told me to keep it after I informed them of their error. The grill is very easy to operate. It heats up very quickly and I noticed during the preheat temperatures reach over 600 degrees (the maximum on the thermometer). The temperature remains consistent as long as you keep the lid down. I have been experimenting so far but my best results have been with direct heat: chicken breasts, salmon filets, pork chops and asparagus. I had mixed results with indirect heat because I need a better thermometer. I ordered a pizza stone because I think this grill will make great crispy crust pizza due to its high temperatures. 

The two wheel design works great for me. My backyard patio is made from pavers and the two weeks move easily over them. I think the original 4 castor design would be a little more problematic. The grill supposedly weighs over 100 pounds but I found no difficulty moving it.

The only negative characteristics are purely cosmetic. The metal surfaces on the grill front and side tables scratch very easily. I tried to polish it up using Dawn and a non-abrasive sponge and it left abrasions. I tried using Simple Green and a paper towel but it didn't polish the metal. The other problem is that the "hubcaps" seem to always pop out when I move the grill. I can't figure how to lock them in place.
Results.Title: A very convenient and efficient grill

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Since I keep my grills in the garage out of the weather they tend to last. When I finally decided it was time for me to step up to a Weber the wait for my old giant box store grill to die became a test of patience. You can only imagine my joy when the cheap wheels on the old grill finally fell off. Since I got my new Spirit Grill I've been thrilled with the performance. Whereas my old grill would barely reach 350 degrees my new Weber was at nearly 600 degrees when I first used it. I've since learned how to use this piece of equipment while roasting and grilling with it. I would recommend this grill for anyone who is serious about grilling, it's awesome.
Results.Title: Like driving a high performance vehicle.

Results.ReviewText: It's exactly what a good grill should be! Clean, simple, efficient and hot to over 500 degrees in SECONDS!  (maybe that's an exaggeration, but it only takes a few minutes, really) The burners light instantly and the flame on all three are remarkably even and full with more than enough cooking space for the two of us and a house full of guests.  Hanging the LP tank out of the way (under the right side shelf) on a gauge that keeps track of the volume is genius! I would HIGHLY recommend this particular grill.  I had many choices to order online or to pick up in person, however, I knew our local ACE Hardware had them in stock so I went to the computer and to my surprise they called me back, immediately, and ended up delivering it (fully assembled) later that the same day and even walked it all the way around the house to set it down where I wanted to use it on my back porch! We bought a new home and now have a GREAT NEW GRILL...we couldn't be happier!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
Purchased 3 months ago and used it AT LEAST weekly since. The Spirit II makes grilling easy and fun, coming from someone who used to own a cheaply made 2-burner years ago, but has used other Webers in the past.

Assembly was not terribly complicated. I watched a video beforehand, and it was about an hour-long job for two people. It fired up perfectly right away, and we've had no problems since.

You probably won't find a better value in a grill. All components are made to last, and the warranty will back that up. I frequently cook for 3-4 people, and even made enough chicken to feed a group of 12 effortlessly. Caveat: If you plan on making 10 ribeyes at a time, this probably isn't the grill for you. It is, however, going to be great for the average user.

I knocked it one star for a very small amount of uneven heating, but I've seen much much worse. You also have to factor in the weather at the time of grilling, and acknowledge that fire is unpredictable. Again, it's only a one star knock because of the MSRP. If it were a $ 5k grill, I would expect perfectly equal heating all around haha.

Finally, the ability to make this grill your own is a huge plus. The Weber cover and utensils complement it well, but I would highly recommend downloading the Weber app. It seriously changed how I grill. Also, the iGrill 3 is a good investment if you frequently cook larger pieces of meat, especially on lower heat. 

All in all, I could only not recommend this grill to someone who plans on usually grilling for a large family of more than maybe 8 people, or someone who wants a grill that looks flashier. My honest opinion is don't pay more to keep up with the Joneses. Just buy this grill and get to cooking.
Results.Title: Amazing value for a family grill
